summary: Independently read all owned canonical/rendered source covering every proposal citation and local contradiction, plus itzako.c 452-691, itgroundcoll.c 44-283 and it_2725.c 176-415. All thirteen proposed corrections fit the inspected code. EnterWait is a meaningful improvement over rendered Init because landing and damage recovery reuse it. Accept upstream deferrals on compiled pools, prototype/final identity, numeric helper semantics and unverified helper internals; preserve retained research unchanged. Reviewer coverage is targeted handoff coverage, not librarian re-enumeration.

proposed_facts.reason: The zero test precedes the nonzero decrement branch. Both falling collision callbacks write xDF8 before invoking the landing helper; locomotion entry occurs on a subsequent invocation after decrement reaches zero.
The table associates state 11 with animation identifier 3. Entry and refresh select 0xB, physics subtracts fall acceleration, and collision returns the shared helper result.
The complete guard, exact -1 facing test, state-1 reselection and alternate state-2 entry match canonical code. The wrapper declares the third argument as Item_StateChangeFlags.
The alternate branch calculates horizontal velocity from incoming facing before assigning -1, so unconditional leftward velocity is not supported.

The grounded jumped-on branch selects state 7, whose table identifier is 2. Independently inspected it_8027C794 is a side-effect-free false stub; completion belongs to the separate animation callback.
The accumulated-damage guard, ordered helper calls, canonical Camera_RequestQuake call, random branch and false return all match the current definition.
Strict threshold excess or current state 6 selects terminal handling; destination entries select states 10 and 11. The ordinary inline branch resets xDF8 and selects state 9.
Shared drop setup precedes the facing test and invokes airborne setup. The selected states 3/4 use falling physics, with the stated wrapper flags.
EnterWait meaningfully improves rendered Init: the helper enters timer-driven state 0 and is reused by falling-state landing and damage-recovery collision handling.
The ordered entry calls and wrapper-installed jumped_on callback match source. Shared reset explicitly clears horizontal/vertical velocity and owner; the local entry does not reset xDF8.
Canonical jumped-on handling contains the stated ordered calls, small quake, ground/air split, item feedback and xCFC fighter-side call.
State-7 entry resets velocity and selects state 7 with flags 2. The table identifier is 2; physics is empty, collision delegates to the verified inert stub, and animation handles completion.
The airborne branch multiplies horizontal velocity by x8 and selects state 8. No local range restriction supports an attenuation or sign-preservation guarantee.

contradictions.reason: Accept deferral of compiled .data layout, section extent and .sdata2 provenance/composition. Twelve source records and inline literal operands establish neither compiled record sizes nor pool placement.

Accept every listed prototype/final-Goomba mapping deferral, including implements edges whose prose says older Goomba but whose target scope remains ambiguous. The inspected callbacks establish Old Kuri behavior, not identity with the final Adventure Mode actor. Preserve supported qualified prototype knowledge and local callback explanations without promoting name equivalence into identity proof.

Accept rejection of the two misattributed Polar Bear/Topi links. The owned implementation and public declarations describe the Old Kuri state machine, not a Polar Bear-owned unit containing Topi functions.

Accept the countdown correction and deferral of a necessarily brief wait: the timer decrements for every nonzero value and is loaded from data before landing queries. EnterWait and its revised purpose resolve the incorrect spawn-only characterization.

Accept state/animation corrections for states 7 and 11, the flags-versus-transition-code correction, and the incoming-facing velocity correction. State 1 can reselect itself; assigning destination facing afterward does not retroactively change the computed velocity.

Accept deferral of unconditional supported-floor state preservation. The shared helper may call Item_8026ADC0 even when floor support remains, and local collision callbacks can continue processing after that helper returns.

Accept tangent-velocity and numeric-helper deferrals. Zero facing explicitly clears velocity, and normal magnitude affects the output. Local calls establish argument 2, not an independently verified bit index, condition slot or detailed animation-event interpretation; orientation internals remain deferred.

Accept falling-state classification for drop and the terminal-speed-cap deferral. Shared drop setup precedes the facing test and invokes airborne setup; destination physics delegates to a helper that gates acceleration rather than clamping overshoot.

Accept damage-guard and camera-symbol corrections. State 6 is selected by throw and independently triggers terminal handling; equality alone does not. Threshold-only explanations and final-actor mappings remain deferred rather than silently retained as proven.

Accept initialization-helper deferrals while retaining directly supported writes and shared reset effects. Hitbox-bit, position-derived-facing, xD0C and orientation explanations are not proved by the local call sites; reset explicitly clears owner and horizontal/vertical velocity.

Accept inert state-7 collision and unrestricted state-8 scaling corrections. The shared collision function only returns false, whereas the separate animation callback performs completion work; multiplying by x8 does not establish a bounded retained fraction.

Tangent-velocity magnitude claims require qualification for zero facing and the supplied normal; attribute ranges remain unestablished.
Exact visual presentations of states 10/11 and visible triggers of the reference-object adapters remain unspecified. Inferred names are not recovered original symbols.
